title: Ballot Exhaustion in Multiwinner Single Transferable Vote Elections
abstract: arXiv:2605.12676v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We study ballot exhaustion in multiwinner single transferable vote (STV) elections using a dataset of 1,070 Scottish local government elections comprising over 5.4 million ballots. While ballot exhaustion has been studied extensively in single-winner elections, comparatively little work examines exhaustion in the multiwinner setting. We introduce formal definitions of several types of exhaustion in STV elections, distinguishing between exhausted ballots, non-first-choice exhausted ballots, unrepresented exhausted ballots, and weight exhaustion. These definitions clarify important conceptual differences between ballots that cease to transfer and ballots that fail to contribute meaningfully to representation. translated_title: 多赢家单一可转移投票选举中的选票耗尽问题
translated_abstract: arXiv:2605.12676v2 公告类型：替换。摘要：我们利用包含超过540万张选票的1070场苏格兰地方政府选举数据集，研究了多赢家单一可转移投票（STV）选举中的选票耗尽现象。虽然选票耗尽在单赢家选举中已被广泛研究，但在多赢家情境下的相关研究相对较少。我们引入了STV选举中几种耗尽类型的正式定义，区分了耗尽选票、非首选耗尽选票、未代表耗尽选票和权重耗尽。这些定义澄清了停止转移的选票与未能对代表性产生有意义贡献的选票之间的重要概念差异。我们的实证分析显示，27.9%的选票在最终计票轮次前耗尽，但相应的权重耗尽率仅为7.1%，表明许多已耗尽的选票此前已对结果做出了贡献。
tldr: 本研究首次系统定义了多赢家STV选举中的多种选票耗尽类型，并通过大规模苏格兰选举数据揭示，尽管27.9%的选票最终耗尽，但权重耗尽率仅7.1%，说明多数耗尽选票已产生实质贡献。
en_tdlr: This study formally defines multiple types of ballot exhaustion in multiwinner STV elections and, using large-scale Scottish election data, reveals that although 27.9% of ballots exhaust, the weight exhaustion rate is only 7.1%, indicating most exhausted ballots have already contributed meaningfully.
